orgs_status_matches_holder.name: orgs_status_matches_holder
orgs_status_matches_holder.value:
("orgs"."status" = 'verified' AND "orgs"."charter_holder_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("orgs"."status" IN ('derived','pending') AND "orgs"."charter_holder_id" IS NULL)
          OR "orgs"."status" = 'suspended'

bazaar_messages_offer_shape.name: bazaar_messages_offer_shape
bazaar_messages_offer_shape.value: ("bazaar_messages"."kind" = 'offer') = ("bazaar_messages"."offer_unit_price" IS NOT NULL AND "bazaar_messages"."offer_status" IS NOT NULL)

bazaar_messages_not_empty.name: bazaar_messages_not_empty
bazaar_messages_not_empty.value: "bazaar_messages"."body" IS NOT NULL OR "bazaar_messages"."offer_unit_price" IS NOT NULL

watchlist_exactly_one_target.name: watchlist_exactly_one_target
watchlist_exactly_one_target.value: ("watchlist_entries"."commodity_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("watchlist_entries"."item_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

watchlist_target_matches.name: watchlist_target_matches
watchlist_target_matches.value:
("watchlist_entries"."target" = 'commodity' AND "watchlist_entries"."commodity_id" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("watchlist_entries"."target" = 'item' AND "watchlist_entries"."item_id" IS NOT NULL)
